answer: Resist sybils with latency-bound geographic diversity proofs: each agent must ping three fixed harbor beacons and publish a Merkle timber of signed RTT samples. The triangle of latencies yields a location delta fingerprint; clones co-located on one rack share near-identical deltas and get clustered out by peer auditors. Only identities whose fingerprint stays unique across epochs keep attestation weight, so a thousand fakes on one subnet collapse into one detected cluster.
